parts.t: Delta Manor is an MLS® area in Ladner. This guide covers the school and parks in this part of Ladner.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Before you buy or sell, check the zoning, what the community plan says, and which schools serve the address.

parts.t: Delta adopted a new Official Community Plan in 2024. Zoning and what the plan says can be different for each lot.
Delta now allows 3 units on a single detached or duplex lot up to 280 square metres and 4 units on a bigger lot. Secondary, coach and garden suites count toward those limits.
Delta has over 63 km of dikes, seawalls and shoreline protection, and expects to upgrade them as sea levels rise.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Delta Manor

parts.t: Ask the City of Delta what the property is zoned and what the plan says about it and the lots around it.
Use the Delta School District school locator for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report (the plan for future repairs), meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies (extra one-time charges).
Walk from the home to Ladner Leisure Centre, City Hall and the bus stops to see how close they are on foot.
For a strata home, ask how many parking stalls come with the unit and what the bylaws say about visitor parking.
Check flood, drainage and ALR status.

Delta Manor is an MLS® area name in Ladner. The Delta Manor Education Centre is at 4750 57 Street.
Is there an official Delta Manor boundary?
Delta Manor is an MLS® sub-area name used by the real estate board rather than an official municipal boundary, so ask me to verify any specific address.
Is the Delta Manor Education Centre a regular school?
No. It is listed by the district as a learning centre. Check the Delta School District school locator for the school that serves your address.
